# Battle of Iași

Battle of Iași may refer to:
* Battle of Iași (1653)
* Battle of Iași (1717)
* First Jassy–Kishinev offensive, 8 April–6 June 1944, Soviet failure
* Second Jassy–Kishinev offensive, 20–29 August 1944, Soviet victory
See also
* Battle of Iasi, now in Turkistan, Kazakhstan
